Kashmiri Travellers Alarmed by Bus Attacks in Haryana and Punjab

Two separate incidents involving attacks on buses carrying Kashmiri travellers have caused alarm. In Haryana, an elderly Kashmiri man was injured when bricks were hurled at a Delhi-Srinagar bus. Subsequently, a similar incident occurred near Ludhiana in Punjab, where a Kashmir-bound bus was attacked with stones. These back-to-back events have raised concerns among Kashmiri travellers.
